name: Container Agent
description: Every generated devcontainer brings up and registers its own a2a-goose agent (`<repo>-dev`), reached over the tailnet by the LiteLLM proxy; reuses the a2a-goose GitHub release channel, so the container has the same self-update path as a host.

emittedFiles.purpose: start/stop/status for this container's agent: writes the Doppler-sourced env file and the agent config, ensures the a2a-goose launcher exists, runs it backgrounded, and fails open when the network is not there.
Runs `scripts/agent-dev.sh start` on every container start (guarded so the file is optional).
`--stop-timeout 30` in runArgs, so `docker stop` gives the agent time to deregister before it is killed.
Names the agent and documents start/stop/status.

optionalReason: The agent is a choice, not a default: it lives in its own `agents` category alongside coding-agents and is not pre-selected or locked, and no `devcontainer-*` depends on it. It depends on `doppler` because both the provider settings and the registration secrets (bearer token, LiteLLM master key/base URL, goose server secret) are read from Doppler at start time; without that capability the CLI is not installed, no context is pinned, and the agent cannot register. Selecting container-agent therefore resolves coding-agents and doppler too.
notInV1: A separate `container-tailnet` capability: the tailnet wiring is unconditional in the devcontainer generator (state volume, runArgs sysctls, post-create install, post-start tailscaled), so it already is the provider and container-agent depends only on coding-agents.
Per-container agent isolation beyond one name per repo: the registry is keyed by name, and one agent per repo is the contract
Baking the agent payload into the image: it is fetched from the a2a-goose release channel so the container self-updates like a host
Declaring the card port in devcontainer forwardPorts: the card is reached over the tailnet, not through a host port forward
